To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
3D CT scan is a valid and useful technique to qualitatively evaluate the outflow graft configuration of minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
CT-SCAN reconstruction with 3D reconstrution is a valid tool to evaluate the out flow tract after minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
3D CT-scan reconstruction is a valid method for qualitative assessment of different minimally invasive LVAD outflow configurations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the outflow tract after a minimally invasive approach.
a qualitative analysis of the outflow tract configurations of the LVAD.
the use of 3D CT reconstruction to evaluate the out flow graft configuration of the different approaches of minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of 3D-CT scan can help the surgeon to evaluate the out-flow tract of LVAD before minimally invasive implantations.
the use of 3D CT reconstruction is useful for evaluating the outflow tract after a minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
3D CT-scan reconstruction of the outflow graft is a valuable tool to assess the route and position of outflow graft after minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
3D-CT-SCAN can provide valuable information to the surgeon in the pre-operative planning and in post-operative evaluation of the LVAD implantation.
the 3D CT-scan can help the surgeons to evaluate and choose the best surgical approach and to plan a better implantation of the LVAD.
3D CT reconstruction is useful in the preoperative planning and postoperative evaluation of LVAD implantation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
3D CT can be used to assess the different outflow graft configurations in the different minimally invasive surgical approaches.
CT-SCAN reconstruction can help to evaluate the different outflow graft configurations after minimally invasive LVAD implantation.
CT-SCAN can be used to evaluate the route of LVAD outflow graft and its configuration.
